lint.command: (cd api && uv run --frozen ruff check app tests)

migrate.command: env_file="${PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH:-.}/.env.paseo"; if [ -f "$env_file" ]; then set -a; . "$env_file"; set +a; fi; export MEDIA_DIR="${MEDIA_DIR:-${PASEO_WORKTREE_PATH:-$PWD}/media}"; export DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL:?not set - create $env_file pointing at a scratch database}"; cd api && uv run --frozen alembic upgrade head

seed.command: env_file="${PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH:-.}/.env.paseo"; if [ -f "$env_file" ]; then set -a; . "$env_file"; set +a; fi; export MEDIA_DIR="${MEDIA_DIR:-${PASEO_WORKTREE_PATH:-$PWD}/media}"; export DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL:?not set - create $env_file pointing at a scratch database}"; export ADMIN_EMAIL="${ADMIN_EMAIL:-admin@example.com}"; export ADMIN_PASSWORD="${ADMIN_PASSWORD:?not set - add it to $env_file}"; export ADMIN_DISPLAY_NAME="${ADMIN_DISPLAY_NAME:-Admin}"; cd api && PYTHONPATH="$PWD" uv run --frozen python scripts/seed.py

api.command: env_file="${PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH:-.}/.env.paseo"; if [ -f "$env_file" ]; then set -a; . "$env_file"; set +a; fi; export MEDIA_DIR="${MEDIA_DIR:-${PASEO_WORKTREE_PATH:-$PWD}/media}"; export APP_BASE_URL="${APP_BASE_URL:-${PASEO_SERVICE_WEB_URL:-http://localhost:4321}}"; export DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL:?not set - create $env_file pointing at a scratch database}"; export REDIS_URL="${REDIS_URL:?not set - add it to $env_file}"; cd api && exec uv run --frozen uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port "$PASEO_PORT" --reload

web.command: env_file="${PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH:-.}/.env.paseo"; if [ -f "$env_file" ]; then set -a; . "$env_file"; set +a; fi; api_port="${PASEO_SERVICE_API_PORT:-8000}"; export API_BASE_URL="${API_BASE_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:$api_port}"; export ASTRO_DEV_BACKGROUND=0; (exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/"$api_port") 2>/dev/null || echo "[paseo] WARNING: nothing is listening on api port $api_port - start it with: paseo script start api"; cd web && exec ./node_modules/.bin/astro dev --port "$PASEO_PORT" --ignore-lock
